quest.title: Pursuit
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}? Didn't we just see each other?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When did we last meet?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Hmm, I'm not sure. After all, it's hard to keep track of time in a place like this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come with me, Canotila.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something about this place doesn't feel right.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Hmm, but don't we get to decide what feels right or not?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Um, I didn't mean to be so deep. But I really like this place. It's full of life and colors, things I've never seen on the other side.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I only saw a sunflower...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Really? Wow! Where?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where we saw the puppy.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Okay! I'm going there now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}! Wait, why isn't Paimon with you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That rift... What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: What rift? Isn't this a mirror?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Well, speaking of that, there is something that I've been looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: I'm trying to find clues to the Looking Glass. It looks like a painting, and lets people meditate in a similar manner to the Book of Revealing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the four orthants and the painting in the Tower of Gestalt...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #...Really? So it's in a place like that? Okay! Thank you, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Go toward where the sound is coming from

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #Thanks, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: I don't know. I just wanted to see the blooming sunflowers and the cute puppy...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: But a monster came after me, and the sky got darker. I heard many voices talking about things that I didn't understand.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: I was scared, so I followed the golden light and ran forward.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: The world got a little darker whenever the monster came near. The garden, the palace, the great trees, and the flowers all disappeared. It was very gloomy, and I only saw ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: And then the monster caught up to me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't have to worry now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Puppy, please send her back.

dialogues.speaker: Puppy
dialogues.text: Don't come around here anymore, little one. There's nothing here, but there's a whole world waiting for you out there.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you the puppy? But...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: ...Will I see you again? Will this world become a beautiful garden again?

dialogues.speaker: Puppy
dialogues.text: No. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Puppy
dialogues.text: And you, let me ask you one more time. What am I in your eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A dog.

dialogues.speaker: Puppy
dialogues.text: That's good. You just got rid of someone who shouldn't be here, and thanks to you, this world's collapse has stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Puppy
dialogues.text: But it is unwise for any of you to stay all the same.

choices.text: I figured as much. Please send me back.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: This world was going to disintegrate, because someone who shouldn't be here arrived, shaking the foundations of this world.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is that why I saw what I saw?

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: I don't know what you experienced. I am not you, after all.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: ...That is not important. What's important is the masters of this imaginary world.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: They believed that they could save the world, but they didn't know if this world actually needed to be saved. Maybe the world in their memories was but an afternoon forever bereft of blooming sunflowers.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: But those are their stories and not mine. I'm just a memory that they have of their friend. They once believed that they could save me, but ultimately...

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: The butterfly became a cocoon, and a larva emerged from the cocoon. Then, the larva returned to the void that was never born.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: But none of these things matter. I have nothing left. I am just a shadow in their memories, left behind by their obsession to save me.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: I don't hate them, though. Even if they changed after losing me, my existence in this world of memories and delusions is proof of their persistence.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: As someone who was once their friend, I am more than satisfied. No matter what I become, I am forever grateful for the friendship we once had.

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: Anyway, let's end it here. You can feel the influence this place has on you, can't you?

response.speaker: Puppy
response.text: Farewell. We won't see each other again.

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The content on the pages still consists of incomprehensible symbols, letters, ancient languages, and geometric figures. But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you still going to meditate?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We haven't found Canotila yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm going to need you to give me another moment, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Okay then! It's just a blink of an eye anyway. Paimon's not worried at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Still, be careful, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That was super fast! Paimon didn't even have time to blink...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...That's a relief.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright! Our little troublemaker's back! Canotila, you made {NICKNAME} really worried, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: *sob* I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon's not blaming you! Don't cry, Canotila. Come on, Paimon will give you something delicious to eat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (What happened?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (We encountered some danger inside.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't cry, Canotila, you're a brave, brave Melusine! Here, this is Paimon's favorite Chicken-Mushroom Skewer. Take it, it's all yours!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: *sob* Thank you so much, Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: *chewing*

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Whoa, such a strange taste! So this is what humans eat for their meals...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! If you don't want it, you can just give it back to Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #But... Thank you. And thank you for saving me, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you plan to do next?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: I don't know, but I don't want to read books anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Canotila, isn't that a bit extreme?

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Well, um... The Book of Revealing is really scary...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (So, what exactly happened?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It's a long story...)

choices.text: (You'd only understand if you were there.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (What do you mean? Ugh, Paimon's getting annoyed...)

response.speaker: Canotila
response.text: ...Anyway, I don't want to stay here anymore. I want to live with everyone in Merusea Village.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! The other Melusines will take good care of you!

choices.text: (It's a good thing you didn't go.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me get ready first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The content on the pages still consists of incomprehensible symbols, letters, ancient languages, and geometric figures. But a period of focus seems to gradually render their meaning comprehensible.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you ready? Paimon will wait here for you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Book of Revealing
dialogues.text: (The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not right now.

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: Argh... Please, help...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It's coming from over there. Gotta be quick.)

dialogues.speaker: Canotila
dialogues.text: #Here, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}! Help me...
